Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for your message.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months, 189,600 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 4.73 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 45 days net, 24-month contract; option B: EUR 4.70 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 24-month contract; option C: EUR 4.78 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 90 days net, 24-month contract. Option A amounts to about EUR 896,808 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-10 you quoted us EUR 5.45 per unit for this part; your new quote is 11.0% above it. Our demand forecast for this part is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
4. Next step: Please send us your cost breakdown for this part. All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for your message.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months, 189,600 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 4.97 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 90 days net, 24-month contract. This amounts to about EUR 942,312 over the term.
3. Basis: Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

3. Basis: We raised quality notifications on this part over the past year (qn:20004725, qn:20004878, qn:20004895, qn:20004922, qn:20004940, qn:20004951, qn:20005016).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
